Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Silver Star Recreation Area
37 Those portions of M.U.s 8-22, 8-25 and 8-26 in the vicinity of Vernon being the Silver Star Recreation Area that are outlined in red on the attached Map No. 7-3/18. [en. B.C. Reg. 115/2018, App. 1, s. 9.]
